title: Zig: FizzBuzz
description: Classic FizzBuzz: print numbers 1-30, replacing multiples of 3 with Fizz, 5 with Buzz, and both with FizzBuzz.

steps.title: FizzBuzz in Zig
steps.description: Loop from 1 to 30. If divisible by 3 and 5 print 'FizzBuzz', by 3 print 'Fizz', by 5 print 'Buzz', else print the number.
